source.method: 实际查看官方缓存PDF47/48/49页，核课程表示例、8识字/2写字、字母造型/3组平翘词组/6动作、7图词及6成语、民间歌谣谁会飞边界；复核星期三第六节劳动。未听来源录音或观察动态书写轨迹。
source.sourcePeriodBoundary: 未读取官方课时安排；分段学习仅为产品建议。

literacyStation.writingEvidence: Textbook static stroke sequence and field position were viewed; no official dynamic trajectory observed or original paths created.
literacyStation.boundary: A textbook example timetable, never the actual child school timetable. Do not add every course-name character to the recognition targets.
readingNotes: 期读qī，数在数学中读shù；模在一模一样中读mú。
课程表以教材示例为依据，不写入或冒充当前儿童的真实课表。

pinyinUse.shapeConstructionBoundary: Use already learned letters for the open construction prompt; accurate geometry/letter identity must remain separate from teaching-flow diagrams.
pinyinUse.boundary: These are whole words/phrases for comparison or action. Preserve neutral-tone li/bo and do not split audio into letter phonemes or automatically expand all annotations into new sound/recognition targets.
readingNotes: 玻璃的li、萝卜的bo为教材无调轻声；西瓜guā在本页明确第一声。
z/zh、c/ch、s/sh作为声母名称/呼读对照；不声称长呼读音就是独立轻短本音。
短语必须按完整音节/完整词组录制，不能把字母声音拼接成词。

wordSentenceUse.boundary: Locate corresponding original scene objects/groups; fixed group counts must be deterministic, not inferred from random AI image detail. Do not generalize to arbitrary measure-word or arithmetic curriculum.

accumulation.boundary: Short narrated picture-supported meanings and examples; figurative 三头六臂 is not literal biology. Do not turn 十全十美 into perfection pressure, points or behavioral judgment.

lessons.title: 语文园地三
targets: 在示例星期三课表中按节次查课；联系午星期语文数写会8字，并按静态笔序描午、下。
用已学字母作可修改造型；比较3组声母及6词组，理解6动作并编排图画顺序。
听读鸡鱼河与4个量词短语，在原创建构图景中定位正确对象及确切组。
用原创图景理解和积累6个成语，比较相同/不同并创作可修改颜色图案。
用原创鸟马鱼画面支持自有书谁会飞共读和自愿表达，不采集或推断实际朗读成绩。
